title: Privacy Policy
content:
Privacy Policy

At Travelluxx, accessible from https://travelluxx.co.uk, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by Travelluxx and how we use it.

Information We Collect

When you book a private hire or transfer with us, we collect your name, phone number, email address, pickup and dropoff locations to deliver executive transport services.
